channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Everful raises $48.5M Series A to build the AI infrastructure layer for global commerce
item.description: Everful raised $48.5 million to build AI infrastructure for global commerce, with agents that find products, vet factories and manage orders across 60 countries.

item.title: LangChain launches LangSmith Tool Gateway in public beta to govern agent tool calls
item.description: LangChain launched LangSmith Tool Gateway in public beta, a control layer that governs which tools AI agents can call, whose credentials they use, and how each action is recorded.

item.title: BigCommerce launches Shopping Agent for merchants as Firmly's Ask Agent reaches 11M+ merchants
item.description: BigCommerce launched a Shopping Agent for merchants and Firmly's Ask Agent now reaches more than 11 million merchants, bringing AI shopping agents to smaller stores.

item.title: Meta names Loblaw the first Canadian retailer on Muse, with meal planning and grocery checkout in-chat
item.description: Loblaw became the first Canadian retailer on Meta's Muse, letting shoppers plan meals, fill a basket and check out without leaving the assistant.

item.title: Metano raises $12M seed to secure AI agents across the enterprise
item.description: Metano came out of stealth with $12 million in seed funding to build security and governance software for enterprise AI agents, led by Sierra Ventures.

item.title: AI-agent USDC transfers surge 498.8% to 11.1 million in 30 days
item.description: AI agents made 11.1 million USDC transfers in the past 30 days, up nearly 500% from the month before, with most of the activity on Base, Polygon and Arc.

item.title: Claude Code 2.1.328 brings Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 auto mode to more hosts
item.description: Claude Code 2.1.328, released today, brings automatic model selection for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 to more cloud platforms, including Bedrock and Microsoft Foundry.

item.title: ServiceNow: 92% of Indian organisations faced an AI agent security incident in the past year
item.description: A new ServiceNow survey found 92% of Indian organisations faced an AI agent security incident in the past year, and 37% discovered agents running in production that security never knew about.

item.title: Microsoft's Intune guide to governing local AI agents: compliance policies, Execution Containers, Defender runtime protection
item.description: Microsoft published a hands-on guide to governing local AI agents with Intune, including preview policies that cut off company data on devices running unapproved agents.

item.description: Wix says its AI app builder Base44 is nearing $250 million in annual recurring revenue, up from $100 million in March, with margins recovering to 58%.

item.description: The group governing the x402 agent-payment standard charges $200,000 a year for a board seat, while the rail itself moved about $274,000 in October.

item.title: Payhawk raises $280M Series C at $2B valuation to expand AI agents for finance operations
item.description: Payhawk raised $280 million at a $2 billion valuation to expand AI agents that handle finance work like procurement, travel and payments, with 77% of its customers already using them daily.

item.title: Pretxt exits stealth with $5M seed to build 'AI Supervision' for enterprise agents
item.description: Pretxt came out of stealth with $5 million to build AI supervision — software that checks enterprise AI agents against company rules while they work.

item.title: Anthropic prices IPO tonight, likely above $80 a share at a $1.5-1.6T valuation
item.description: Anthropic is expected to price its IPO tonight above its $70–$78 range, possibly over $80 a share, with trading under the ticker ANT starting Thursday.

item.description: Security researchers report Microsoft's official agent-framework package on PyPI was published with a credential stealer — developers should check pinned versions before installing.

item.title: Two Claude API calls stop working Nov 30: Sonnet 4.5 retires, Opus 4-8 fast mode removed
item.description: Two Claude API calls stop working November 30: the Sonnet 4.5 model string retires and fast mode is removed on Opus 4-8, so developers need to migrate now.

item.description: OpenAI is bringing computer-use agents to healthcare teams, letting AI operate software by clicking and typing to handle clinical and admin workflows.

item.title: Meta makes its enterprise AI bet official: Muse agent, Business Agent, Muse API and Muse Code
item.description: Meta is taking its Muse AI agent to the enterprise, bundling it with a business agent, an API and a coding tool as its next major business pillar.
